title: Item:Mirror of Shadows
wikitext:
[[File:Mirror of Shadows.png|thumb|Mirror of Shadows]]
''Objects in this mirror appear dark and distorted, as if you were looking not at a reflection but into an entirely different world.''

{{Bind|No|drops=leaving}}

: On use: When near the Shadowfell Nexus, you are transported between the Prime Material Plane and the Shadowfell.
: Cooldown: 15 seconds

'''Notes:'''
* Received on entering [[Through a Mirror Darkly]].
* Using this item shifts you between light and shadow side.
* Using this item does NOT break invisibility.
* It is usually a good idea to place the item on a hotbar for easy access, you're going to use it a lot.
* If you're interrupted while using the mirror (for example by taking damage), the item goes on cooldown but you stay where you were.
